features.capability: Accrues interest daily on a deposit account's balance, delegating the rate calculation to any injected interest type so that flat, tiered and overdraft interest all share one accrual engine.
features.client_functionality: The customer sees interest building up on their account every day rather than only when it is paid. Accrued amounts are held on separate ACCRUED_INTEREST_PAYABLE / ACCRUED_INTEREST_RECEIVABLE addresses, so a statement can show 'interest earned so far this month' before the application date, and closing the account mid-period still settles the interest actually earned. Because the rate is supplied by an injected interest type, the same customer experience is produced whether the bank offers a single rate, balance tiers, or a different rate on overdrawn balances.

requirements.statement: Interest must accrue daily on the customer's cleared balance at the rate applicable to that balance.
The bank must be able to configure the day-count convention used to convert an annual rate to a daily rate.
Accrued interest must post to the correct internal account depending on whether it is payable to or receivable from the customer.

products.summary: An operating account for a corporate customer, divided into named sub-accounts such as operating, payroll and tax reserve. Each sub-account carries its own balance, its own transaction limits and its own entitlements, while interest, fees and regulatory reporting are assessed on the pooled position across all of them.

requirements.statement: A corporate customer can hold several named sub-accounts under one banking relationship, each with its own balance and its own transaction limits, so that operating cash, payroll and tax reserves are ring-fenced from one another.
Interest and fees are assessed on the pooled balance across all sub-accounts, so the customer is not penalised for organising their money into several pots.
A shortfall on one sub-account can be covered automatically from a nominated funding sub-account, up to a configured limit, before any overdraft is used.
Each sub-account can restrict which payment types and counterparties may debit it, so a payroll pot cannot be spent on card transactions.
Every posting is attributed to exactly one sub-account, and a statement can be produced per sub-account as well as for the relationship as a whole.

products.summary: A capital-and-interest repayment mortgage on declining-principal amortisation, with daily interest accrual, monthly due amount calculation, overdue and delinquency handling, overpayment with an annual allowance, redraw, and an optional offset against a linked Personal Current Account that reduces the balance interest is charged on.

requirements.statement: The customer repays capital and interest in equal monthly instalments over an agreed term, recalculated whenever the rate or term changes.
Interest is charged daily on the outstanding principal, reduced by any balance held in a linked offset account, so a customer with savings pays less interest without losing access to those savings.
A missed instalment moves the amount to overdue, notifies the customer, and after the configured grace period marks the account delinquent.
The customer may overpay up to an annual allowance without charge, may redraw previous overpayments, and is charged an early repayment fee beyond the allowance.

linked_products.description: The linked current account's cleared balance is mirrored onto this account's offset tracker address and subtracted from the principal that interest accrues on. Modelled as a PrincipalAdjustment so the accrual engine itself needs no change, and deliberately without a Supervisor Contract: the current account pushes the mirror posting, exactly as lending.disbursal.disbursement already posts across accounts.

products.summary: An everyday current account with credit interest, an arranged overdraft, monthly maintenance and minimum-balance fees, and transaction limits. It is also the offset counterparty for the mortgage: its cleared balance is mirrored to the mortgage so the customer pays interest only on the difference.

requirements.statement: The customer earns credit interest on cleared balances, accrued daily and applied monthly.
The customer may go overdrawn up to an arranged limit; beyond it the transaction is refused or an unarranged overdraft fee applies.

Where the customer nominates this account as an offset against their mortgage, its cleared balance reduces the mortgage balance that interest is charged on, and the customer keeps full access to the money.

linked_products.description: When set, this account mirrors its cleared balance onto the mortgage's offset tracker address after every posting and on a daily schedule, so the mortgage can reduce its accrual base without reading another account's balances.
